Hi {{{NAME}}}, top of your Pathfinder list was {{{TOP_MATCH}}}.

Employers don’t give you one deadline. Each scheme has its own window, some only two or three weeks long, and most big employers close early once they have enough applications. Barclays opened its 2027 banking scheme on 9 September and closed it on the 25th.

So the order matters. The best applications go in during the first fortnight of each window, which means being ready before it opens.

That’s what the free call is for: 30 minutes putting your matches in order and working out what each stage will ask of you.
